title: FIRST CONTACT
description: Your first day as a NEXUS operator. Learn the terminal by visiting the public training node ECHO.
goal: Connect to the virtual server ECHO and inspect it.
story_start: MIRA: "Welcome aboard, {player}. NEXUS is the network that watches over the other networks, and you are its newest pair of eyes."
MIRA: "Let's start gently. ECHO is a training node — safe, sandboxed, a little lonely. Say hello."
MIRA: "Everything you see is a simulation inside NEXUS. Nothing out there can be hurt by what you type here."

objectives.hint: Hidden files start with a dot: ls -a, then cat .signal

story_end: MIRA: "Clean. Quick. Exactly the way I like it. ECHO has been quiet for years — I'm glad you made it talk."

messages.text: Nicely done, {player}. Something was left on ECHO for the next operator. Mission 002 is ready when you are: 'mission start 2'.
